per_candidate.id: s2:Alpha Element Populations Among Local Halo Stars
s2:Estimating the Initial Mass of the Gaia–Enceladus Dwarf Galaxy with a Chemical E

rationale: Papers 2206.07744 and 2206.10505 provide substantive new evidence on the formation processes of the Galactic stellar halo, particularly focusing on the Gaia-Sausage/Enceladus merger event and its contributions. However, the question remains partially addressed as the full complexity of the halo's formation is not entirely resolved.
